verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's order and hierarchy (eyebrow, headline, rule, body, a prominent orange CTA, then 'Ships late June'). Its flaws: the dark header no longer runs the full width, so it reads as a floating block; the SOLSTICE logo is tiny; the headline and body are small for 300x250; and the legal line can't be read. B breaks the hierarchy: the body copy is nearly as big as the headline and fills the left column, while the 'Reserve a Case' CTA shrinks to a tiny pill crammed into the right column next to the unreadable legal text. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow is effectively lost, and the two columns leave the layout lopsided and cramped.
